_about: Memoir (parts) grades and starting sub-status slots, a server-side table master data lacks. Every memoir exists as 5 grades (EntityMParts.PartsInitialLotteryId, the game's 'Sub No.'); a dropped memoir's grade is rolled by its rarity's gradeOdds (weights), then the grade's startingSlots lists the slot counts it can start with, each equally likely (grade 5 is always full). Every upgrade level in upgradeLevels (3, 6, 9, 12, 15) fills an empty slot, or adds a roll to a random filled one. To become EntityS* tables in the database later.
